description: Create a new Google Sheets spreadsheet with the given title. Returns its id. Requires a connected account.
embedding_description: Create a brand-new, empty Google Sheets spreadsheet with a given title and return its spreadsheet id. That id is then the 'id' argument for every other Sheets verb (sheets_get_values, sheets_update_values, sheets_append_values, sheets_export). Fails gsuite.not_connected if no account is linked.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dict with the new spreadsheet id.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Confirm the spreadsheet was created and give its id for follow-up reads/writes.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Create a new Google Sheets spreadsheet.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: gsuite.invalid_params: missing title. gsuite.not_connected: no account linked.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: gsuite.invalid_params: supply a title. gsuite.not_connected: run connect_account.
